verdict.rationale: Jan runs local models through a llama.cpp backend and lets users import GGUF files or pull models from Hugging Face, which implies it can run quantized model files. However, no evidence explicitly mentions quantization levels, choosing a bit-width, or memory savings. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported integer quantization levels (very low-bit through 8-bit), a quantization selection UI or workflow, memory-footprint guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
